name: 48th Annual Charlotte County Chamber Christmas Parade in Punta Gorda
host: the Charlotte County Chamber of Commerce
address: Staging at Charlotte Performing Arts Center, 701 Carmalita Street, Punta Gorda, FL 33950
when_note: Saturday, December 12, steps off at noon
paras: The Charlotte County Chamber of Commerce announced that its 48th Annual Christmas Parade takes place on Saturday, December 12, 2026, with the theme Sleigh Bells and Seashells. The chamber expects more than 100 entries, including decorated floats, marching bands, local businesses, community groups and festive vehicles.

A local events calendar carrying the chamber's listing says the parade steps off at noon and runs to about 2:30 PM. It stages at the Charlotte Performing Arts Center, 701 Carmalita Street, travels from Carmalita north on Taylor Street, and disbands at the Charlotte Harbor Event and Conference Center, 75 Taylor St.
The same listing says the public is invited free of charge and suggests bringing blankets and lawn chairs to set up along the route.
Only the official Santa Claus designated by the chamber may ride in the parade, so children can look for one Santa near the end of the line.
The chamber estimates 3,000 to 4,000 spectators on the sidewalks and gives its office phone as 941-627-2222.
tip: Set up chairs along Taylor Street before noon, because the route draws thousands of watchers.

name: Babcock Ranch Tree Lighting Festival
address: 42881 Lake Babcock Drive, Babcock Ranch, FL 33982
paras: Babcock Ranch kicks off its holiday season with the 2026 Tree Lighting Festival at Founder's Square on Friday, December 4, from 5:30 to 9 PM. The Babcock Ranch Residential Association lists it as a holiday event for all ages with a $0.00 fee.
Families watch Santa light the Christmas tree, browse food trucks and walk the lit boardwalk. The association promises more holiday events through December.
This year's holiday setup adds a new ice rink powered through a partnership with Peoples Gas and E2Companies, which use natural gas and microgrid technology.

The association encourages registering ahead so its lifestyle team can plan, and registration requires an account. It asks guests to keep pets leashed and children off bikes and scooters in the event area.
tip: Register ahead on the association's catalog, then arrive at 5:30 PM for the tree lighting.

name: Santa Fest at Estero Recreation Center
paras: Lee County lists Santa Fest at the Estero Recreation Center for Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 10 AM to noon at 9200 Corkscrew Palms Blvd.
The morning includes story time, hot cocoa, holiday crafts, a chance to shop for holiday treasures and a visit with Santa, and the county suggests bringing a camera for photos.
Admission to Santa Fest and the Winter Yard Sale is free, and pre-registration is required for Santa Fest at leeparks.org/register.
tip: Register at leeparks.org before the morning, since Santa Fest requires pre-registration.
